<ic>Respond to a request for funding to add two rituals to the body of Imperial Lore.<br><br>''Proposed by Feroz, seconded by Morrow.''</ic>

===Overview===
* A request for funds to be used by the [[Dean of the Lyceum]] to add two rituals to the body of [[Formulaic_ritual#Imperial_Lore_and_the_Ritual_List|Imperial Lore]].
* Passed at 20 Thrones

===Date===
* Spring 378YE

===Progress===
* Funds disbursed to Sallur I Mnajdra I Guerra, Senator for Feroz

===Campaign Outcome===
* The rituals [[The Cuckoo's Egg]] and [[Clad in Golden Raiment]] were added to the body of Imperial Lore in accordance with the [[Declaration#Declaration of Imperial Lore|decision]] of the [[Conclave]].
